extracted.name: Best Ever Shrimp Dip
extracted.description: Like shrimp salad, but thicker and heartier, this dip showcases the fresh taste of seafood.
instruction_lines: In a medium bowl, mix together cream cheese and mayonnaise. Mix in onion, celery and shrimp meat. Cover bowl, and refrigerate before serving.
